title: Goya scene language revised to RUGID-compatible syntax

scope.objective: Adopt the RUGID scene grammar as the Goya surface language: @ontology/@cell/@button blocks with absolute and proportional geometry, hex colours, inline properties. Deliver lexer, parser, deterministic layout, hit testing, fuzzer, and a live scene-file GUI demo.

implementation_record.notes: goya-lang is std-only except goya-chroma for colour space interop. Design decisions: absolute geometry is parent-origin-relative (matches RUGID calculator layout); proportional geometry is a fraction of parent extent; undeclared extent fills parent; anonymous ontology wrapper collapses when it holds a single named cell; geometry clamps into parent; unknown properties consumed and ignored for forward compatibility. 5x7 glyph renderer reused for text.

results.unit_tests: 176 passed, 0 failed (25 suites; goya-lang: 5 incl. 10k-input mutation fuzz)
results.scene_demo: ontology 'goya_workspace' parsed, 7 nodes, proportional centring PASS, hit test PASS
results.live: 1800 frames presented from scene file, no protocol errors

notable_findings.wrapper_collapse: The ontology block is syntactic wrapper; without collapsing it, its default extent clamped all children to half the viewport — caught by the first live-layout test.
